name: Reduce image size when pasting in the chat
description:
1. Enhanced the image editor in `ChatAttachmentPreview.vue` with a scale-based size control and an estimated final file size in KB.
2. Reorganized the UI per feedback: zoom moved outside the edit section (view tool), while rotation, crop, resize, file-name editing, and the expected KB "Output" all live inside the edit tools panel.
3. Set aspect ratio to locked by default, changed zoom to 10% steps, and made the image preview a fixed-height, centered, scrollable canvas.
4. Made the canvas preview reflect live edits (rotation, crop, resize) instead of just the raw source.
5. Fixed persistence by forwarding the `update-attachment` event up through `ChatEntry` → `ChatMessageList` → `Chat.vue`, which saves changes via `chatSvc.updateExistingMessage`.
